snippet.title: Coffee Raccoons - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Coffee Raccoons is coming soon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4448200/Coffee_Raccoons/

Run your intergalactic brewing business as you explore alien worlds in search of rare ingredients. Upgrade your machines, unlock quirky space gear, and journey to distant planets to discover new flavors. Craft irresistible menus and grow your café into a legendary coffee destination among the stars!
